modules.title: AIRWINDOWS
modules.blurb: Chris Johnson's Airwindows effects, all of them: reverbs, saturators, compressors, filters, dithers and more. Pick one and the knobs become its parameters.

modules.title: BEADS
modules.blurb: Mutable Instruments' Beads: a granular texture synthesizer that records what comes in and scatters it as grains, or as a pitch-shifting multitap delay.

modules.title: BRAIDS
modules.blurb: Mutable Instruments' macro oscillator: 47 digital and analogue-style shapes, two parameters, a pitch and a trigger.

modules.title: KEYS
modules.blurb: Your notes: pitch, gate, velocity, the mod wheel and the bend.

modules.title: CLOCK
modules.blurb: Tempo as pulses: 16ths, 8ths, beats and bars; locked to the song or free.

modules.title: SEQ
modules.blurb: Sixteen steps of pitch (or rest) advanced by a clock.

modules.title: LFO
modules.blurb: A slow oscillator for movement.

modules.title: NOISE
modules.blurb: White and pink noise.

modules.title: S&H
modules.blurb: Samples its input on each trigger (noise when unpatched).

modules.title: SLEW
modules.blurb: Smooths a signal: glide, lag and portamento.

modules.title: ATT
modules.blurb: Scales, flips and offsets a signal.

modules.title: QUANT
modules.blurb: Snaps a pitch to a scale.

modules.title: ENV
modules.blurb: An ADSR envelope opened by a gate.

modules.title: VCO
modules.blurb: A band-limited oscillator: sine, triangle, saw, pulse.

modules.title: DRUM
modules.blurb: A kick, snare or hat voice, struck by a trigger.

modules.title: SVF
modules.blurb: A state-variable filter: low, band, high and notch together.

modules.title: LADDER
modules.blurb: A Moog-style ladder filter that sings when pushed.

modules.title: VCA
modules.blurb: Amplifier: its level set by a control signal.

modules.title: MIX
modules.blurb: Four inputs to one.

modules.title: FOLD
modules.blurb: A wavefolder: harmonics from folding the wave back on itself.

modules.title: DRIVE
modules.blurb: Soft overdrive.

modules.title: CRUSH
modules.blurb: Sample-rate and bit reduction.

modules.title: SCOPE
modules.blurb: A screen on the wall: the wave of whatever is patched in, passed on.

modules.title: DELAY
modules.blurb: A stereo echo: free or tied to the song's tempo, with a ping-pong.

modules.title: CHORUS
modules.blurb: Thickens a sound with a slow, swimming copy of itself.

modules.title: OUT
modules.blurb: The output: to the speakers, and out of the room to a track.

modules.title: WORLD
modules.blurb: The room itself as a source: the weather, the venue's instrument, the looper's rings, each a level and a gate.

modules.title: HAND
modules.blurb: The CV bench in the room as a source: five boxes of two knobs and a slider, set by a hand at the board.

modules.title: PHASER
modules.blurb: Sweeps notches through a sound for a slow, swirling whoosh.

modules.title: FLANGER
modules.blurb: A short, swept delay that sounds like a jet passing: combs sliding through a sound.

modules.title: TREMOLO
modules.blurb: Makes a sound swell and dip in volume, steadily.

modules.title: AUTOWAH
modules.blurb: A filter that opens and closes with how loudly you play: wah-wah without a pedal.

modules.title: PITCH
modules.blurb: Moves a sound up or down in pitch without changing its speed.

modules.title: LIMIT
modules.blurb: Pushes a sound up and stops its peaks from going over: louder without clipping.

modules.title: SOAP
modules.blurb: A band filter with a pass output and a reject output: keep one band, or cut it out.

modules.title: AD
modules.blurb: A one-shot envelope: up in the attack time, down in the decay time, each trigger.

modules.title: COIN
modules.blurb: A coin toss for every trigger: it lets a gate through or holds it back, by chance.

modules.title: WANDER
modules.blurb: A smoothly wandering random level: a slow, drifting change that never repeats.

modules.title: FM
modules.blurb: Two sine waves, one bending the pitch of the other: bells, basses and metal.

modules.title: FORMANT
modules.blurb: A voice-like oscillator: a resonant peak you can slide, as in vowels.

modules.title: VOSIM
modules.blurb: A buzzy, vocal oscillator made of squared sine pulses: robot voices and throaty basses.

modules.title: SHAPER
modules.blurb: One oscillator that slides from a saw, through a triangle, to a pulse as you turn the shape.

modules.title: VARISAW
modules.blurb: A saw with a notch and a ramp you can bend: bright, hollow and in between.

modules.title: ZOSC
modules.blurb: A windowed-sine oscillator with a sweepable formant: sharp, nasal and synthetic.

modules.title: ADDITIVE
modules.blurb: Sixteen sine harmonics added together: sculpt a tone by choosing which overtones ring.

modules.title: ORGAN
modules.blurb: Seven saw and square waves an octave apart, mixed by hand: strings and organ pads.

modules.title: DUST
modules.blurb: Random clicks, some loud and some soft, as often as you ask: crackle, rain and random triggers.

modules.title: STEPNOISE
modules.blurb: Noise that changes only at a set rate: stepped random levels, or a buzzy, gritty tone when fast.

modules.title: PARTICLE
modules.blurb: A shower of tiny pings: dripping, sparkling, rattling, from a few to a swarm.

modules.title: GRAINLET
modules.blurb: A pitched, formant oscillator made of sine grains: vocal, plucky and smeared.

modules.title: FRACTAL
modules.blurb: Layered noise from slow to fast: wind, rumble and hiss, with a colour that goes dark to bright.

modules.title: SYNKICK
modules.blurb: A kick drum built from a falling sine, a click and a dab of noise: punchy and tuneable.

modules.title: SYNSNARE
modules.blurb: A snare from a pitched shell and a rattle of noise: crack, snap and body.

modules.title: MODAL
modules.blurb: A struck bar, bell or glass: a voice built from a few ringing resonances.

modules.title: STRING
modules.blurb: A plucked string: guitar, harp and zither, from a trigger and a pitch.

modules.title: KARPLUS
modules.blurb: A string with no pluck: feed it a click, a burst of noise or a drum to make it ring at a pitch.

modules.title: RESON
modules.blurb: Makes any sound ring like a struck object: a bar, a plate or a tube, at the pitch you give it.

modules.title: DRIP
modules.blurb: A bubbling water drop for every trigger.

modules.title: ELEMENTS
modules.blurb: Mutable Instruments' modal synthesizer: bowed, blown and struck exciters into a resonator, then a reverb.

modules.title: SPECTRUM
modules.blurb: A screen of glowing bars, low notes on the left to high on the right: what is in a sound, as it plays.

modules.title: VECTOR
modules.blurb: Draws one signal against another: a mono sound is a line, a wide stereo sound a cloud, two sines a loop.

modules.title: METER
modules.blurb: Two level bars with a peak tick that lingers: how loud, and how close to clipping.

modules.title: PLASMA
modules.blurb: A lava lamp for your patch: three signals stir the colours, the glow and the flow of a liquid picture.

modules.title: MARBLES
modules.blurb: Mutable Instruments' random sampler: three related random gates, and random notes in a scale that can loop what they just did.

modules.title: PLAITS
modules.blurb: Mutable Instruments' macro oscillator: 24 engines from virtual analogue to modal, granular, drums and speech.

modules.title: RINGS
modules.blurb: Mutable Instruments' resonator: strike it with a trigger and hear modal bodies, strings and bells.

modules.title: REVERB
modules.blurb: A lush plate-like reverb from Mutable Instruments' Clouds.

modules.title: CLOUDS
modules.blurb: Mutable Instruments' granular processor: listens to what comes in and plays it back as a cloud of grains.

modules.title: PEAKS
modules.blurb: Mutable Instruments' dual function generator: an envelope, LFO, tap LFO, bouncing ball, mini sequencer, pulse shaper or randomiser, or a bass, snare, hat or FM drum. P1..P4 mean: ENV attack/decay/sustain/release; LFO rate/shape/shape param/phase; TAP LFO level/shape/param/phase; BALL gravity/bounce/height/speed; SEQ the four steps (reset input restarts); SHAPER delay/length/gap/repeats; RANDOM accept/repeat/delay/jitter; BASS pitch/punch/tone/decay; SNARE pitch/tone/snap/decay; HAT none; FM pitch/fm/decay/noise. Drums play on out, the rest on cv.

modules.title: STAGES
modules.blurb: Mutable Instruments' segment generator: a gate runs up to four segments of level, time and shape as an envelope, a looping ramp, a small step sequencer, a timer chain or an LFO.

modules.title: STREAMS
modules.blurb: Mutable Instruments' dual dynamics gate: an envelope, vactrol, follower, compressor or Lorenz generator shaping a signal as a VCA, a low-pass or both.

modules.title: TIDES
modules.blurb: Mutable Instruments' tidal modulator: a gate or clock in, four related slopes out, from an envelope to an LFO to an oscillator.

modules.title: WARPS
modules.blurb: Mutable Instruments' meta-modulator: two signals in, one out, from ring modulation and folding to a vocoder.
